title: Down to the River (to Pray)
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #173, printed page A 34 (as “As I went down”). Staff notation appears in 8notes.com — Down to the River to Pray, lead sheet (traditional). A free alternative is Michael Kravchuk free lead sheet.
melody_note: Extracted from the 8notes.com lead-sheet MIDI (traditional Appalachian spiritual; public domain) — melody taken as the top voice of the two-voice arrangement. Verse + chorus, one pass. The book carries it as “As I went down” (A p.34, song #173).
verdict: Verdict: high confidence — machine extraction of the standard tune (as popularized by Alison Krauss, O Brother Where Art Thou). Check the book's word sheet for the Rainbow variant.
